glossary.definition: (1) "Discharge of dredged material" has the same meaning as in 33 CFR 323.2 as effective February 16, 2001.
glossary.source_title: Section 6111.028 - Discharge of dredged material into isolated wetlands.

glossary.definition: (2) "Dredged material" means material that is excavated or dredged from isolated wetlands. "Dredged material" does not include material resulting from normal farming, silviculture, and ranching activities, such as plowing, cultivating, seeding, and harvesting, for production of food, fiber, and forest products.
glossary.source_title: Section 6111.028 - Discharge of dredged material into isolated wetlands.
